issue_context.body:
@kennytm @xhebox 

Run `go test -tags reserved_words_test -check.f TestCompareReservedWordsWithMySQL ` fails with:

```
FAIL: reserved_words_test.go:70: testConsistentSuite.TestCompareReservedWordsWithMySQL

reserved_words_test.go:95:
    c.Assert(err, ErrorMatches, errRegexp, Commentf("MySQL suggests that '%s' should *not* be reserved!", kw))
... error string = "this authentication plugin is not supported"
... regex string = ".*ADD.*"
... MySQL suggests that 'ADD' should *not* be reserved!

OOPS: 0 passed, 1 FAILED
--- FAIL: TestT (0.00s)
FAIL
exit status 1
FAIL	github.com/pingcap/tidb/parser	1.108s
```

@xhebox suggests to remove the file and I'd like to hear from the original author @kennytm also.

cc @djshow832
comments: You can always add back if you think it's still valid with a fix. I don't think keeping a broken file makes sense.
It reminds of this pingcap/docs#6195. But I agreed that it should probably be removed.

can be fixed by #29087 

but we may need a regression guard.

okay.

the variable `require` is introduced in `parser.y`. it could be changed to `requireKwd` if you like but that would also be a very massive change 😞.

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/64167a000fbdae9c97a137ca583e191d939bb03d/parser/parser.y#L227
since `require` -> `requires` happens in `parser` package only (yet), I tend to keep current way. At least the solution you proposed here deserve a separate round to landing :)
